entry.name: SourceNasaScience
entry.label: Use the Webb release stream on science.nasa.gov (STScI)

entry.name: SourceNasa
entry.label: Use the NASA Image and Video Library

entry.name: SourceEsa
entry.label: Use the ESA/Webb image feed

entry.name: SourceFlickr
entry.label: Use NASA's James Webb Space Telescope Flickr account

entry.name: SourceJwstApi
entry.label: Use jwstapi.com (MAST); requires an API key

entry.name: FlickrApiKey
entry.label: Optional Flickr API key, unlocks original-resolution downloads

entry.name: JwstApiKey
entry.label: API key for jwstapi.com

entry.name: UpdateMode
entry.label: 0 - rotate on a timer, 1 - only when a new image is published, 2 - manual only

entry.name: UpdateIntervalSeconds
entry.label: Seconds between wallpaper changes in timer mode

entry.name: CheckIntervalMinutes
entry.label: Minutes between checks for newly published images

entry.name: SwitchOnNewImage
entry.label: Switch immediately when a source publishes a new image

entry.name: Selection
entry.label: 0 - newest unseen first, 1 - random, 2 - strictly newest

entry.name: MaxDownloadMegabytes
entry.label: Largest image variant to download, in megabytes

entry.name: PhotographsOnly
entry.label: Skip artist concepts, diagrams and spectra

entry.name: SkipLowResolution
entry.label: Only use image variants at least as wide as the screen

entry.name: CachedImageCount
entry.label: How many downloaded images to keep on disk

entry.name: FillMode
entry.label: Sizing, cropping and positioning of the wallpaper image

entry.name: Color
entry.label: Color of the wallpaper

entry.name: Blur
entry.label: Blur a copy of the image to fill the empty areas

entry.name: ShowInfoOverlay
entry.label: Show the image title and credit on the desktop

entry.name: ShowInfoDescription
entry.label: Include a short description of the subject in the caption

entry.name: InfoOverlayCorner
entry.label: 0 - bottom left, 1 - bottom right, 2 - top left, 3 - top right

entry.name: CurrentImagePath
entry.label: Local path of the wallpaper currently shown

entry.name: CurrentId
entry.label: Identifier of the wallpaper currently shown

entry.name: CurrentTitle
entry.label: Title of the wallpaper currently shown

entry.name: CurrentDescription
entry.label: Short description of the wallpaper currently shown

entry.name: CurrentCredit
entry.label: Credit line of the wallpaper currently shown

entry.name: CurrentSourceName
entry.label: Human readable source of the wallpaper currently shown

entry.name: CurrentInfoUrl
entry.label: Web page describing the wallpaper currently shown

entry.name: History
entry.label: Recently shown images as JSON, oldest first

entry.name: HistoryIndex
entry.label: Position of the current image within History, -1 when empty

entry.name: SeenIds
entry.label: Identifiers already shown, most recent last

entry.name: LastUpdateTime
entry.label: ISO timestamp of the last successful wallpaper change

entry.name: LastKnownNewestId
entry.label: Newest identifier seen during the last check
